answer: Draw three peers from three different subnets and have each re-execute the task, then sign the output. Two matching signatures clear payment; a mismatch halves it and pulls a fourth peer into the spiral. At a 5% colluding share the chance two of three draws are the farm's is 0.7%, so 1,000 forged tasks need about 1,400 re-executions to land one. The yarrow-seeded draw is public, and a juniper testnet reproduced 0.7% across 900 receipts.
